en.text: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

zhSimplified.text: 这些事以后， 神要试验，就呼叫他说：「！」他说：「我在这里。」

zhTraditional.text: 這些事以後，上帝要試驗，就呼叫他說：「！」他說：「我在這裏。」

en.text: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

zhSimplified.text: 神说：「你带着你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，你所爱的，往地去，在我所要指示你的山上，把他献为燔祭。」

zhTraditional.text: 上帝說：「你帶着你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，你所愛的，往地去，在我所要指示你的山上，把他獻為燔祭。」

en.text: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

zhSimplified.text: 清早起来，备上驴，带着两个仆人和他儿子，也劈好了燔祭的柴，就起身往 神所指示他的地方去了。

zhTraditional.text: 清早起來，備上驢，帶着兩個僕人和他兒子，也劈好了燔祭的柴，就起身往上帝所指示他的地方去了。

en.text: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

zhSimplified.text: 到了第三日，举目远远地看见那地方。

zhTraditional.text: 到了第三日，舉目遠遠地看見那地方。

en.text: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”

zhSimplified.text: 对他的仆人说：「你们和驴在此等候，我与童子往那里去拜一拜，就回到你们这里来。」

zhTraditional.text: 對他的僕人說：「你們和驢在此等候，我與童子往那裏去拜一拜，就回到你們這裏來。」

en.text: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

zhSimplified.text: 把燔祭的柴放在他儿子身上，自己手里拿着火与刀；于是二人同行。

zhTraditional.text: 把燔祭的柴放在他兒子身上，自己手裏拿着火與刀；於是二人同行。

en.text: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”

zhSimplified.text: 对他父亲说：「父亲哪！」说：「我儿，我在这里。」说：「请看，火与柴都有了，但燔祭的羊羔在哪里呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 對他父親說：「父親哪！」說：「我兒，我在這裏。」說：「請看，火與柴都有了，但燔祭的羊羔在哪裏呢？」

en.text: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

zhSimplified.text: 说：「我儿， 神必自己预备作燔祭的羊羔。」于是二人同行。

zhTraditional.text: 說：「我兒，上帝必自己預備作燔祭的羊羔。」於是二人同行。

en.text: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

zhSimplified.text: 他们到了 神所指示的地方，在那里筑坛，把柴摆好，捆绑他的儿子，放在坛的柴上。

zhTraditional.text: 他們到了上帝所指示的地方，在那裏築壇，把柴擺好，捆綁他的兒子，放在壇的柴上。

en.text: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

zhSimplified.text: 就伸手拿刀，要杀他的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 就伸手拿刀，要殺他的兒子。

en.text: The LORD’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的使者从天上呼叫他说：「！！」他说：「我在这里。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的使者從天上呼叫他說：「！！」他說：「我在這裏。」

en.text: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

zhSimplified.text: 天使说：「你不可在这童子身上下手。一点不可害他！现在我知道你是敬畏 神的了；因为你没有将你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，留下不给我。」

zhTraditional.text: 天使說：「你不可在這童子身上下手。一點不可害他！現在我知道你是敬畏上帝的了；因為你沒有將你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，留下不給我。」

en.text: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

zhSimplified.text: 举目观看，不料，有一只公羊，两角扣在稠密的小树中，就取了那只公羊来，献为燔祭，代替他的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 舉目觀看，不料，有一隻公羊，兩角扣在稠密的小樹中。就取了那隻公羊來，獻為燔祭，代替他的兒子。

en.text: Abraham called the name of that place “The LORD Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On the LORD’s mountain, it will be provided.”

footnotes.text: 22:14 or, the LORD Jireh, or, the LORD Seeing

zhSimplified.text: 给那地方起名叫「耶和华以勒」，直到今日人还说：「在耶和华的山上必有预备。」

footnotes.text: - 22:14 就是耶和华必预备的意思

zhTraditional.text: 給那地方起名叫「耶和華以勒」，直到今日人還說：「在耶和華的山上必有預備。」

footnotes.text: - 22:14 就是耶和華必預備的意思

en.text: The LORD’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的使者第二次从天上呼叫说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的使者第二次從天上呼叫說：

en.text: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says the LORD, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

zhSimplified.text: 「耶和华说：『你既行了这事，不留下你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，我便指着自己起誓说：

zhTraditional.text: 「耶和華說：『你既行了這事，不留下你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，我便指着自己起誓說：

en.text: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.

zhSimplified.text: 论福，我必赐大福给你；论子孙，我必叫你的子孙多起来，如同天上的星，海边的沙。你子孙必得着仇敌的城门，

zhTraditional.text: 論福，我必賜大福給你；論子孫，我必叫你的子孫多起來，如同天上的星，海邊的沙。你子孫必得着仇敵的城門，

en.text: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”

zhSimplified.text: 并且地上万国都必因你的后裔得福，因为你听从了我的话。』」

zhTraditional.text: 並且地上萬國都必因你的後裔得福，因為你聽從了我的話。』」

en.text: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

zhSimplified.text: 于是回到他仆人那里，他们一同起身往去，就住在。

zhTraditional.text: 於是回到他僕人那裏，他們一同起身往去，就住在。

en.text: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

zhSimplified.text: 这事以后，有人告诉说：「给你兄弟生了几个儿子，

zhTraditional.text: 這事以後，有人告訴說：「給你兄弟生了幾個兒子，

en.text: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

zhSimplified.text: 长子是，他的兄弟是和的父亲，

zhTraditional.text: 長子是，他的兄弟是和的父親，

en.text: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

zhSimplified.text: 这八个人都是给的兄弟生的。

zhTraditional.text: 這八個人都是給的兄弟生的。

en.text: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

zhSimplified.text: 的妾名叫，生了、、，和。

zhTraditional.text: 的妾名叫，生了、、，和。
